t: Hong Kong dollar - Wikipedia
s: November 10, 2025 - The Hong Kong dollar (Chinese: 港元, sign: HK$; code: HKD) is the official currency of Hong Kong. It is divided into 100 cents. Historically, it was also divided into 1000 mils. The Hong Kong Monetary Authority is the monetary authority of Hong Kong and the Hong Kong dollar.

t: Hong Kong Currency: a Travelers' Guide to Money in HK
